tasks.short: Determine the violation and issue the notice.

steps.what: List stored permit clauses for the violation notice.
Determine the violation and attend the enforcement hearing.
Review the written notice against the stored facts.
File the signed written notice of violation.

tasks.design: Written notices of violation are drafted in {DOCS} only from permit clauses and inspection facts already stored. The inspector determines the nature of the violation, the action to take, and attends any enforcement hearing. The notice is filed in the {GOV_PORTAL} only after the inspector signs that version. A missing clause stops the draft.
tasks.previous_blocker: Notices were typed from memory after the hearing, and a clause from another permit was copied in.
tasks.enabler_now: The permit clauses and the inspection facts can be listed before the inspector writes.
tasks.still_hard: A violation the stored facts do not describe, and a hearing that turns on what was said.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector can see a matching clause that does not fit what was found on the site.
tasks.altitude: The clause list is open before the hearing. The inspector still determines the violation and still signs the notice. Nothing is filed unsigned.

reach.task: Record a site finding the notice has to rest on.
reach.learn: The finding can be in the file. The notice is still signed here.

evidence.claim: A notice can quote a permit clause already in the file. It cannot decide the violation or replace the hearing.
EU GDPR article 22 bars a solely automated decision that issues a violation notice. The inspector determines the nature of the violation and signs the notice. A clause list does not issue it.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An environmental inspector in a mid-size European organisation. National permit rules apply. A list does not issue a notice or allow a discharge.

Fields: Permit id, clause id, and inspection fact id, produced by the permit file. A notice with no clause id is not drafted. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the inspector finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the permit register the organisation already keeps.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the inspector.
unknowns: Which authority receives the filed notice.
Which hearings the inspector must attend in person.
research_questions: What share of notices already cite a stored clause?
Who may sign a notice besides the inspector?

already_counted.description: The inspector still determines the violation and attends the hearing.
The inspector still reviews the written notice.

incremental.description: The inspector rewrites a notice whose cited fact was corrected.

approvals.approved_version: notice version and the violation facts the draft cites

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is the clause list already in the file. It disappears when the clause is missing and the inspector writes from the permit book. The hearing and the decision stay with the inspector.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: File an inspection record when the site id is present.
Organize inspection notes and photos that have no site id.
Maintain the inspection record index the inspector accepts.

tasks.design: Inspection records are filed in {DOCS} when the site id, the date, and the inspector id are already on the note. Notes and photos with no site id stay with the inspector to organize. The index lists only records the inspector has accepted. A record with a missing id is not filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Notes came back in a notebook and were typed into a shared folder days later, often under the wrong site.
tasks.enabler_now: A note that already carries a site id can be filed the day it is written.
tasks.still_hard: A photo with no site, and a note that covers two sites.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector can tell which site a messy photo belongs to.
tasks.altitude: Complete notes are in the record the day they are written. The inspector still sorts the notes that have no site id. The index does not add a site the note did not name.

reach.task: File a site record against a location id before anyone reports on it.
reach.learn: The id can be checked. The messy note is still sorted here.

evidence.claim: An inspection note with a site id can be filed without retyping. A note with no site id cannot be placed.
A record is filed only when the required ids are already stored. A drafted sentence may cite only a figure or a rule already in the file. A sentence with neither stops.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An environmental inspector in a mid-size European organisation. National permit rules apply. A list does not issue a notice or allow a discharge.
Fields: Site id, date, and inspector id, produced by the inspection note. A note with no site id is not filed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the inspector finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the document store the organisation already keeps.
unknowns: Which photos are required on a record.
How long inspection records are kept.
research_questions: What share of notes already carry a site id?
Who else may add a document to the record?

already_counted.description: The inspector still organizes notes with no site id.
The inspector still maintains the index.

incremental.description: The inspector retitles a record whose site id was wrong.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is filing a note that already has a site id. It disappears when the note has no id and the inspector sorts it by hand. The index does not invent a site.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Open the complaint file on illegal dumping or pollution.
Investigate the suspected dumping, pollution, or labeling on site.
Record which violations the site visit supports.

tasks.design: The complaint is opened from {DOCS} so the inspector has the address and the alleged dumping, pollution, pesticide, or labeling issue. The investigation on site stays with the inspector. The note records only violations the visit supports. A complaint with no address is not turned into a finding.
tasks.previous_blocker: Complaints arrived by phone and were written up after the visit, sometimes against the wrong address.
tasks.enabler_now: The complaint file can be open before the inspector leaves.
tasks.still_hard: A site that does not match the complaint, and a labeling question the file does not describe.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector can see dumping that the complaint described in the wrong place.
tasks.altitude: The complaint is open before the visit. The inspector still investigates. The file does not decide that a violation occurred.

reach.task: Walk a reported site before writing what was found.
reach.learn: The file can be opened. The visit cannot be skipped.

evidence.claim: A complaint file can be opened before a visit. It cannot investigate dumping, pollution, or labeling.
The site visit, the sample, and the interview stay with the inspector. A stored reading is not a finding. A label is not a sample.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An environmental inspector in a mid-size European organisation. National permit rules apply. A list does not issue a notice or allow a discharge.

Fields: Complaint id and address, produced by the complaint file. A complaint with no address is not listed as ready. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the inspector finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the complaint store the organisation already keeps.
unknowns: Which complaints must be visited the same day.
Who else attends a pesticide complaint.
research_questions: What share of complaints already have an address?
Which findings are always referred to another authority?

already_counted.description: The inspector still investigates the complaint on site.
The inspector still records the violations the visit supports.

incremental.description: The inspector reopens a complaint whose address was wrong.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is opening the complaint before the visit. It disappears when the address is missing and the inspector searches for the site. The investigation time is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List open violation reports with their site and date.
Determine which sites to investigate and coordinate agencies.
Record the enforcement priority the inspector chooses.

tasks.design: Open violation reports are listed in {DOCS} with the site and the date. The inspector determines which sites to investigate and coordinates compliance and enforcement with other government agencies. The list does not rank a site by a score. A report with no site is not offered as a choice.
tasks.previous_blocker: The week’s sites were picked from memory and from whoever called last.
tasks.enabler_now: The open reports can be listed with dates before the inspector chooses.
tasks.still_hard: Two agencies that want the same site on different days, and a report that is not a real violation.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector can tell which site should go first when the dates look alike.
tasks.altitude: The open reports are visible before the week is planned. The inspector still chooses the sites and still talks to the other agencies. No score assigns the work.

reach.task: Choose which reported sites are visited first.
reach.learn: A date list can be prepared. The choice of site stays here.

evidence.claim: Open reports can be listed by site and date. The list cannot choose which site to investigate.

A field compare does not register a product, approve a discharge, or change a procedure. The inspector decides, including that no action is taken. EU GDPR article 22 bars a solely automated decision with a legal effect.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An environmental inspector in a mid-size European organisation. National permit rules apply. A list does not issue a notice or allow a discharge.

Fields: Report id, site id, and date, produced by the violation report. A report with no site id is not listed as a choice. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the inspector finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the report list the organisation already keeps. The list stores no score of the inspector.
unknowns: Which agencies must be called before a visit.
research_questions: What share of reports already have a site id?
Which choices are always made with another authority?

already_counted.description: The inspector still chooses the sites and coordinates the agencies.
The inspector still records the priority.

incremental.description: The inspector updates a choice after an agency changes the day.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is the list of open reports with sites and dates. It disappears when a report has no site and the inspector hunts for it. Choosing the site and talking to agencies stay with the inspector.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The inspector still determines the violation and still walks the complaint. A complete inspection record can be filed before that judgement, and it does not issue the notice.
reach: Government property inspectors record a site finding against a permit, and this job learns a missing site id stays in the notebook.
Regulatory affairs specialists watch named rules, and this job learns a list of clauses is not the enforcement decision.
skills_to_grow: Cite the permit clause a written notice relies on.
Keep the hearing and the site choice with the inspector.
role.ambitious_version: Open cases show their dates and permit status before the inspector chooses a site, and the notice is still signed by that person.
